# LearnWithMillie

> Professional online English tutoring from Millie Cooper, a certified TEFL teacher based in London — Business English, conversation and job interview preparation for learners, plus mentorship, courses and free tools for English teachers.

Millie has five years of experience teaching English online. She holds a Master's in Public Policy from UCL and a Bachelor's in International Politics from King's College London. Lessons are 50 minutes, one-to-one, held online via Google Meet, and a free 15-minute trial is available.

## For students

- [English lessons for students](https://learnwithmillie.com/students): Personalised tutoring in Business English, conversational fluency and interview preparation, with flexible scheduling.
- [About Millie](https://learnwithmillie.com/about): Background, qualifications and teaching approach.
- [Contact](https://learnwithmillie.com/contact): Book a first lesson or a free 15-minute trial.

## For English teachers

- [Teacher hub](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers): Mentorship, self-paced courses and free classroom tools for English teachers.
- [Teaching journey](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/journey): The five stages of an online English teaching career, with the right course or tool for each.
- [Courses](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/courses): Set up a tutoring business, market it across five channels and convert trial lessons with a 5-phase framework.
- [The BOOKED Trilogy](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/courses/course-full): All three courses together — 35 modules, lifetime access.
- [GET READY](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/courses/get-ready): Setting up an online English tutoring business — TEFL, platforms, tech, rates, profile and intro video.
- [GET BOOKED](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/courses/get-booked): Getting students — marketing and a 5-phase trial-lesson framework.
- [STAY BOOKED](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/courses/stay-booked): Keeping a full calendar — lesson structure, retention systems and AI workflows.
- [Mentorship](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/mentorship): One-to-one mentorship on teaching skills, lesson design and online presence.
- [Platform Finder](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/platform-finder): Answer 7 questions to find which of 33 online teaching platforms fit you, ranked by pay and fit.
- [Debate Generator](https://learnwithmillie.com/teachers/debategenerator): ESL debate topics with key vocabulary for speaking practice.
- [Free ESL lesson plans](https://learnwithmillie.com/teacher-materials): Downloadable, ready-to-use classroom materials.
